# Capital Gains Calculator HQ

> Free capital gains tax calculator at capitalgainscalculatorhq.com with 2026 federal and state rates. Estimates short-term and long-term capital gains tax, the 3.8% NIIT, and state tax on stocks, crypto, or a home sale, including the home-sale exclusion. No sign-up, private, free.

Key facts:
- Uses 2026 federal brackets (0%/15%/20% long-term rates), the 3.8% net investment income tax, and every state's own treatment of capital gains.
- Compares short-term vs long-term outcomes and handles the primary-home-sale exclusion.
- All math runs in the browser; no financial data is uploaded or stored.

## Pages

- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://capitalgainscalculatorhq.com/): The federal and state estimator.
- [Capital Gains Tax Explained](https://capitalgainscalculatorhq.com/guide): Short-term vs long-term, how gains stack on income, NIIT, the home-sale exclusion, and legal ways to pay less, for 2026.
- [Home Sale Tax Exclusion](https://capitalgainscalculatorhq.com/home-sale-exclusion): How the Section 121 $250k/$500k exclusion works, the 2-of-5-year ownership and use tests, what's taxed above the limit, and when it doesn't apply.
- [Capital Gains Tax FAQ](https://capitalgainscalculatorhq.com/faq): Common questions on short-term vs long-term rates, the 0/15/20% brackets, NIIT, state tax, the home-sale exclusion, crypto, and privacy.
- [About](https://capitalgainscalculatorhq.com/about): What the tool does and the privacy approach.
